instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Engineering design consultancy providing structural, MEP, and sustainability consulting for large-scale commercial and infrastructure projects. The team leverages industry-standard tools like Revit and IES VE but operates without formalized CAD/BIM workflows or standardized data management protocols. Currently operating from a single location with very limited management layers, the firm relies heavily on individual engineer expertise rather than documented organizational knowledge.
answers.pastInitiatives: We experimented with a customer self-service portal two years ago after seeing competitors offer similar functionality. We built an MVP with an external agency in 3 months, but customer adoption was disappointing — only 8% of customers created accounts. This failure highlighted a gap between technical build and market need.
answers.strategicGoals: Targeting 30% year-over-year top-line growth. We see untapped demand in adjacent customer segments, specifically focusing on specialized carbon offset compliance consulting. The core question is whether to deepen our vertical specialization into sustainable infrastructure or broaden horizontally by offering integrated design and sustainability services.
answers.additionalContext: The company is currently struggling to standardize its project documentation across different engineers due to the informal process. There is a recognized need for standardized knowledge management tools but no internal bandwidth or budget allocated for implementation.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: Implement Low-Code Internal Knowledge Base
opportunities.rationale: Given the informal process and talent constraints, a low-code platform (e.g., SharePoint or Notion) can quickly digitize project documentation and institutional knowledge, improving internal efficiency without requiring extensive development resources.

first_actions: Select and pilot a low-cost platform for departmental documentation.
Identify two key engineers to document standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Allocate 50 hours of existing staff time per month for initial setup.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in time spent locating project documents by 25%
milestones: SOP documentation for structural design finalized (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Targeted Niche Service Development (Adjacent Growth)
opportunities.rationale: To pursue growth, Forge should develop a highly specialized consulting package focused on the identified adjacent market: carbon offset compliance for infrastructure projects. This leverages existing expertise in MEP and sustainability but creates a distinct revenue stream.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study on demand for carbon-related audits.
Develop a preliminary service scope document.
Identify one partner company or consultant to co-develop the offering.
execution_plan.success_metric: Conversion of 1 pilot project into a recurring service agreement within 9 months.

opportunities.title: Integrate Generative AI for Initial Design Optimization (Bold)
opportunities.rationale: While the budget is tight, integrating a simplified generative design tool could dramatically reduce initial conceptual engineering time and allow engineers to explore hundreds of structural iterations rapidly. This bold shift addresses the talent bottleneck by augmenting existing staff efficiency.

first_actions: Identify a specific AI-driven parametric modeling plugin compatible with Revit/IFC.
Allocate dedicated funding for high-performance computing access or SaaS licensing.
Design a highly controlled, low-risk project to test the tool's output.
resources_needed: Dedicated senior staff time for training (40 hours)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in initial structural modeling cycle time by 30% on pilot projects.
milestones: Successful demonstration of AI-assisted design results (Month 4)

next_steps.action: Establish a formalized, documented project intake and knowledge management workflow.
Initiate the feasibility study for carbon offset compliance consulting service.
Pilot integration of a low-code knowledge base solution to address talent bottleneck and informal processes.

key_weaknesses: Lack of standardized engineering workflows, leading to inconsistent quality.
Extreme reliance on individual talent; high risk if key personnel leave.
Very low digital maturity (Maturity Level 1) preventing scalable process improvements.
Informal decision-making which risks misallocation of limited budget and missed market opportunities.
